questions.prompt: What did the general promise to the soldiers before the battle?
questions.answer: Quid imperātor mīlitibus ante proelium prōmīsit?

questions.prompt: Whose voice do we hear echoing through the empty halls?
questions.answer: Cuius vōcem per vacuās aulās resonantem audīmus?

questions.prompt: To whom shall we entrust the keys of the citadel tonight?
questions.answer: Cui hāc nocte clāvēs arcis crēdēmus?

questions.prompt: Who has dared to touch the neck of the sacred bull?
questions.answer: Quis cervīcem taurī sacrī tangere ausus est?

questions.prompt: What sort of marriage do the gods reject with such anger?
questions.answer: Quod coniugium deī tantā īrā respuunt?

questions.prompt: For whom did the poet compose these mournful verses?
questions.answer: Cui poēta haec carmina flēbilia composuit?

questions.prompt: What do the winds carry across the vast frozen sea?
questions.answer: Quid ventī trāns mare vāstum gelidum ferunt?

questions.prompt: Whose horses do you see running through the open plain?
questions.answer: Cuius equōs per campum apertum currentēs vidēs?

questions.prompt: What kind of leader fears the complaints of the crowd?
questions.answer: Quī dux querellās turbae timet?

questions.prompt: With what weapon did the hero slay the raging beast?
questions.answer: Quō tēlō hērōs bēstiam saevientem interfēcit?

questions.prompt: What do the little leaping children fear in the dark forest?
questions.answer: Quid parvulī salientēs in silvā obscūrā timent?

questions.prompt: With whom did you sail across the sea, having left your homeland?
questions.answer: Cum quō trāns mare, patriā relictā, nāvigāvistī?

questions.prompt: What sort of gift, pray, pleases the angry goddess?
questions.answer: Quodnam dōnum deae īrātae placet?

questions.prompt: Whom, eager to avenge his father, do you follow?
questions.answer: Quem, patrem ulcīscī cupiēns, sequeris?

questions.prompt: Who has been chosen to rule the unruly people?
questions.answer: Quis ad populum impotentem regendum ēlectus est?

questions.prompt: What did the merchant bring back from the marine shores?
questions.answer: Quid mercātor ab ōrīs marīnīs rettulit?

questions.prompt: By whom was the tower raised on the highest hill?
questions.answer: Ā quō turris in summō colle ērēcta est?

questions.prompt: What kind of hope remains for those who have lost everything?
questions.answer: Quae spēs eīs quī omnia āmīsērunt manet?

questions.prompt: What did the tongue of the poet, striving to please, sing?
questions.answer: Quid lingua poētae, placēre cōnantis, cecinit?

questions.prompt: Whose commands must we obey in these dangerous times?
questions.answer: Cūjus imperiīs hīs perīculōsīs temporibus pārēre dēbēmus?

questions.prompt: What sort of teacher, pray, punishes the diligent boy?
questions.answer: Quīnam magister puerum dīligentem pūnit?
